task.question: Which ticker has the single highest closing price recorded on any day in the database? Return the ticker.

result.question: Which ticker has the single highest closing price recorded on any day in the database? Return the ticker.
result.cited_sql:
SELECT i.ticker
FROM prices p
JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id
ORDER BY p.close DESC
LIMIT 1
